scope: Technical GPX availability and official course-version review for top-level events 21–30
safetyRules: Existing GPX files remain valid until a replacement is officially published, downloaded, parsed and validated.
No GPX files were deleted, overwritten or replaced in this package.
Official download buttons and interactive Map + GPX panels do not count as successful binary retrieval.
Do not accept year-mismatched historic tracks as current 2027 courses.

checks.officialPageEvidence: The 2027 TMCDC 185K page states 185km, 3500m D+, start 30 April 2027 and exposes a Download GPX control. The page links all seven route pages.
checks.detail: Previously recorded direct URLs for all seven routes remain candidates, but no GPX bytes were retrieved or parsed in this technical pass. A 2026 STCN URL must not be used as 2027.

Three direct GPX filenames are MBT_60k_ULTRA.gpx, MBT_41K_MARATHON.gpx and MBT_16k_short.gpx. MBT_24k_medium.gpx is only a candidate although the organizer distance is 26.4km. Need parse geometry and compare measured length before using it.
Organizer sends race pack and route details around one month before the event; event has seven race options rather than the three previously listed in the app. Wait for official race pack.
Organizer confirms 6.706km/351hm and links Garmin Connect route. No direct downloadable GPX endpoint extracted.
Existing tracks are for CTR26, 24 October 2026. Do not mark them as a 2027 course or substitute them for a future edition.

The event homepage exposes five principal race disciplines. The one earlier candidate file named Transvulcania_12K.gpx has no year in its filename; it is not accepted as confirmed 2027 until organizer metadata or file content is verified. Other links point to TRV24 and are stale.
UTMB event page lists 13–16 May 2027, but race map and GPX content identified in earlier review remains labelled 2026. Reject as current 2027 track pending updated map/files.
Official FAQ states that because the race crosses private areas, GPX is emailed only 1–2 weeks before the event. No public current GPX to download now.

Correction to the old shorthand: official Eryri 80K route is 78km / 2500m+, starts 14 May 2027; the official page says final GPX downloads become available two weeks before the event. Other race pages need separate per-distance checks.
No official 2027 GPX published. Third-party listing also indicates route trace is not yet published; app distance options need reconciliation with the organizer's 2027 race offering.

summary.important: The inspection tools cannot currently retrieve external GPX binaries as file bytes. For Menorca and Malcesine this package records the official download endpoints/routes as pending technical validation; no success is claimed.
